description_en: Creates or modifies an alert contact
description_zh: 创建或者修改告警联系人
name: CreateOrUpdateContact

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the alert contact.

Leave this parameter empty to create a new alert contact.
Specify an ID to modify the specified alert contact
parameters.help_zh:
告警联系人ID。

不填代表创建新的告警联系人。
填写代表修改指定告警联系人信息
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the alert contact
parameters.name: contact_name

parameters.help_en:
The phone number of the alert contact.

You must specify at least one of the Phone and Email parameters. Each phone number or email address can be used for only one contact
parameters.help_zh:
告警联系人手机号码。

Phone和Email参数至少填写一项。每个手机号码或邮箱只能用于一个联系人
parameters.name: phone

parameters.help_en:
The email address of the alert contact.
You must specify at least one of the Phone and Email parameters. Each phone number or email address can be used for only one contact
parameters.help_zh:
告警联系人邮箱地址。
Phone和Email参数至少填写一项。每个手机号码或邮箱只能用于一个联系人
parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en:
The retry type for failed phone notifications.

0: Do not retry.
1: Call again.
2: Send an SMS message.
3 (default): Use the global default value
parameters.help_zh:
电话通知失败后，通知补发类型。

0：不补发
1：重复拨打一次电话
2：发送短信通知
3（默认）：使用全局默认值
parameters.name: reissue_send_notice

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the email address is verified
parameters.name: is_email_verify

parameters.help_en: The webhook URL of the DingTalk chatbot
parameters.name: ding_robot_url

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the alert contact in the enterprise organization, which is used for the @mention feature in third-party IM applications
parameters.help_zh: 告警联系人在自己企业组织内的标识，用于三方IM的@功能
parameters.name: corp_user_id

ContactId.description_en: The ID of the alert contact

ContactName.description_en: The name of the alert contact

DingRobotUrl.description_en: The webhook URL of the DingTalk chatbot

Email.description_en: The email address of the alert contact

IsVerify.description_en:
The verification status of the phone number.

`false` (default): Not verified.
`true`: Verified.

You can call the SendTTSVerifyLink operation to verify the phone number of the contact. Only verified phone numbers can be used for phone notifications in notification policies
IsVerify.description_zh:
手机号码验证标识。

`false`（默认）：未验证。
`true`：已验证。

您可以通过调用SendTTSVerifyLink接口验证联系人手机号，仅验证过的手机号可以在通知策略中使用电话的通知方式
